OUR STORY

The Story of SkyyRose

Four Collections, A Bloodline, and the Heir to the Throne.

SkyyRose is more than a brand—it is a promise. To my daughter. To our city. To every soul that believes in turning pain into purpose and dreams into reality.

READ OUR STORY

IN CONVERSATION

The Blox interview
PLAY THE INTERVIEW

Watch the original interview on YouTube ↗

The Birth of the Rebrand.

SkyyRose was never just a clothing brand. It was a promise — born in Deep East Oakland, forged by a single father who refused to let his circumstances write his daughter’s story. Corey Foster named the brand after his reason for everything: his daughter, Skyy Rose.

The rebrand is the full realization of that promise. Four collections, each with its own world, its own story, its own identity — unified under one crown. Oakland-born luxury streetwear that doesn’t apologize for where it came from. It celebrates it.

Fashion was always self-expression. Growing up in Oakland’s toughest neighborhoods, what you wore said everything — who you were, where you were going, what you refused to accept. SkyyRose carries that energy into every thread, every stitch, every rose.

“I drew the first rose on a night I couldn’t afford dinner. Broke, a baby on the way, every manufacturer I’d worked with had scammed me. But I sat there sketching that script logo until 4 AM because something in me knew — if I could get this right, everything changes. Signature is that night made permanent.”

Corey Foster — Founder & CEO

THE TOWN

Oakland. Always.

The Town never asked permission to be itself. Neither did he. Lake Merritt at golden hour, the 510 humming under everything, Mac Dre on the speakers like a saint — that’s the studio. The studio is also a laptop on a folding table at the airport lounge between shifts. Both things true. Both things the brand.

Deep East · The Hills · Stone City · The 100s · Brookfield · Sobrante Park · Coliseum · Real Oakland · The Shows · Sequoyah Highlands · Lake Merritt · The 510

The first rose, the first script. Where SkyyRose began — gold-accented luxury streetwear, gender-neutral by default.

Dark, powerful, unapologetic. Silver-on-black, gothic restraint. Streetwear armor for everyone who refused to apologize first.

THE GRIEF

Love Hurts

A collection named after grief, made to be worn anyway. Crimson and deep red, Beauty & the Beast cadence — luxury or witchcraft, take your pick.

EXPLORE LOVE HURTS

THE HEIR

Kids Capsule

Rose gold and soft pink. The fourth chapter, smaller silhouettes, same craftsmanship. Passing the torch on the same terms that built the brand.

EXPLORE KIDS CAPSULE

The Beginning

Single father in Deep East Oakland. Searching for something his daughter could wear. Nothing fit the eye. He made it himself. The brand carries her name.

2021

Three Chapters Drop

Black Rose. Love Hurts. Signature. Three collections, one name — not a launch, a declaration.

Maxim names Corey Foster one of 14 game-changing entrepreneurs to watch. The work travels past the city limits.

San Francisco Post profile. Best Bay Area Clothing Line Award. CEO Weekly cover story. The Blox interview. Independent press confirms what Oakland already knew.

2026

Shipping & Returns
Shipping Policy

SkyyRose LLC · skyyrose.co

Last updated: June 5, 2026

This Shipping Policy explains how SkyyRose LLC (“SkyyRose,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) processes, ships, and delivers orders placed on skyyrose.co. By placing an order you agree to the terms described below. For questions not answered here, contact us at support@skyyrose.co.

Contents
Order Processing Times
Domestic Shipping (US)
International Shipping
Customs, Duties & Import Taxes
Order Tracking
Pre-Order Shipping
Lost, Stolen, or Delayed Packages
Incorrect Address & Undeliverable Packages
Contact
1. Order Processing Times

All orders are processed within 1–3 business days (Monday through Friday, excluding US federal holidays) from the date payment is confirmed. During new collection drops or major holiday periods (e.g., Black Friday/Cyber Monday, Christmas), processing may extend to up to 5 business days due to elevated order volume.

Orders are not shipped or delivered on weekends or US federal holidays. Once your order has been dispatched you will receive a shipping confirmation email containing your tracking number and a link to track your shipment in real time.

Note: Processing time is separate from and in addition to the carrier transit times listed in the sections below.

2. Domestic Shipping (US)

We offer the following shipping options for orders delivered within the contiguous United States, Alaska, and Hawaii:

Method	Estimated Delivery Time	Cost
Standard Shipping	5–7 business days	$17
Express Shipping	2–3 business days	$22
Free Standard Shipping	5–7 business days	Free on orders $200.00 or more (before taxes)

Delivery time estimates begin on the day of shipment (after processing) and are provided by the carrier. SkyyRose does not guarantee delivery dates and is not responsible for carrier delays outside our control.

The free standard shipping threshold is calculated on the pre-tax merchandise subtotal. Shipping charges, taxes, and fees do not count toward the threshold. The discount is applied automatically at checkout when the threshold is met.

3. International Shipping

SkyyRose ships to 40+ countries worldwide. Shipping rates for international orders are calculated dynamically at checkout based on the destination country and the total weight and dimensions of your order. You will see the exact shipping cost before completing your purchase.

Estimated international delivery time is approximately 10–14 business days from the date of shipment, depending on the destination country, customs processing times, and carrier routing. Some destinations may experience longer transit times due to local postal infrastructure or regulatory requirements.

International shipping availability and rates are subject to change. SkyyRose reserves the right to restrict shipping to certain countries or regions at any time.

4. Customs, Duties & Import Taxes

When an order is shipped to a destination outside the United States, it may be subject to import duties, customs fees, value-added tax (VAT), goods and services tax (GST), or other charges levied by the destination country. These charges are the sole responsibility of the recipient.

SkyyRose does not collect, pre-pay, or reimburse import duties, customs fees, or taxes of any kind. These amounts are not included in the shipping cost displayed at checkout or charged at the time of purchase.

Customs and regulatory processing by destination-country authorities may cause additional delays beyond the estimated transit times stated above. SkyyRose has no control over customs clearance timelines and cannot be held responsible for delays resulting from customs inspection or regulatory review.

If a package is refused or returned due to non-payment of import duties or failure to clear customs, the customer is responsible for any resulting return shipping fees, and the original shipping cost will not be refunded.

5. Order Tracking

Once your order has been shipped, you will receive a shipping confirmation email containing your tracking number and a direct link to the carrier’s tracking portal. Tracking information may take up to 24 hours to appear in the carrier’s system after the confirmation email is sent.

To track your order:

Open your shipping confirmation email and click the tracking link, or
Visit the carrier’s website and enter your tracking number manually, or
Log in to your account on skyyrose.co and view the order status under My Orders.

If you did not receive a shipping confirmation email within 5 business days of placing your order, please check your spam or junk folder before contacting us at support@skyyrose.co.

6. Pre-Order Shipping

Certain SkyyRose products are available for pre-order in advance of their production or release date. The following terms apply to all pre-order purchases:

Payment: Your card is charged in full at the time of pre-order, not at the time of shipment.
Estimated ship date: The estimated ship date for each pre-order item is displayed on the product page at the time of purchase. These dates are estimates and may be subject to change due to production, supply chain, or logistics factors.
Separate shipment: Pre-order items ship separately from any in-stock items included in the same order. You may receive multiple shipments and tracking numbers for a single order containing both in-stock and pre-order items.
Cancellations: Pre-orders may be cancelled for a full refund up to 48 hours before the estimated ship date. After that threshold, the standard Refund & Return Policy applies once the item has been delivered.
Notifications: You will receive an email notification when your pre-order item has been dispatched, including a tracking number.

For full pre-order terms, including cancellation rights and payment conditions, please review our Terms of Service.

7. Lost, Stolen, or Delayed Packages

SkyyRose is not responsible for packages that are lost, stolen, or delayed after the carrier has accepted and scanned the shipment. However, we will do our best to assist you in resolving delivery issues.

If your package appears lost or significantly delayed:
Verify the shipping address on your order confirmation matches your intended delivery address.
Check with neighbors, building management, or any safe-drop location specified at checkout.
Allow up to 3 additional business days beyond the estimated delivery date before reporting a loss, as carrier delays can cause temporary tracking gaps.
Contact us at support@skyyrose.co with your order number and tracking number. We will open an investigation with the carrier on your behalf.
If your package is marked “Delivered” but you have not received it:

Check all possible delivery locations (mailbox, front door, parcel locker, reception desk). If the package cannot be located, contact us at support@skyyrose.co within 7 days of the marked delivery date so we can initiate a carrier claim.

Carrier delay disclaimer: Delivery time estimates are provided by the carrier and are not guaranteed. SkyyRose is not liable for delays caused by carrier operations, weather events, natural disasters, strikes, acts of government, or any other circumstances beyond our reasonable control.

8. Incorrect Address & Undeliverable Packages

The customer is solely responsible for providing an accurate and complete shipping address at the time of checkout. SkyyRose is not responsible for orders shipped to an incorrect or incomplete address provided by the customer.

If you realize you entered an incorrect address, contact us immediately at support@skyyrose.co. Address corrections can only be made before the order enters the fulfillment queue. Once the package has been dispatched, we cannot guarantee that an address change is possible.

If a package is returned to us by the carrier as undeliverable due to an incorrect address, a failed delivery attempt, refusal of delivery, or an unclaimed parcel, the following applies:

We will contact you using the email address on file to arrange reshipment.
Reshipment to the corrected or original address will be charged at the applicable shipping rate.
If you do not respond within 30 days of our notification, the order may be subject to restocking and the merchandise refunded minus the original shipping cost and any applicable restocking fee.

Original shipping costs are non-refundable for packages returned due to an incorrect address or failed delivery resulting from customer error.

9. Contact

For shipping inquiries, order status questions, or to report a delivery issue, please reach out to our customer support team:

Email: support@skyyrose.co
Mailing address: SkyyRose LLC, 3400 Cottage Way, Suite G2, Sacramento, CA 95825

We aim to respond to all inquiries within 1–2 business days. Response times may be longer during high-volume periods such as new collection launches and major holiday seasons.

For returns or exchange inquiries, please see our Refund & Return Policy. For general legal or terms inquiries, contact legal@skyyrose.co.

Privacy Policy

SkyyRose LLC · skyyrose.co

Last updated: June 5, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how SkyyRose LLC collects, uses, shares, and protects information about you when you visit skyyrose.co or purchase from us, and describes the rights available to you under applicable law.

How We Collect It

Cookies & Tracking Technologies

1. Scope & Who We Are

SkyyRose LLC (“SkyyRose,” “we,” “our,” or “us”) is a California limited liability company operating the luxury streetwear brand and online store at https://staging-7e48-skyyrose.wpcomstaging.com (“the Site”). Our principal place of business is in Oakland, California.

This Privacy Policy applies to personal information collected through the Site, our WooCommerce-powered store, and any related communications or services we provide. It does not apply to third-party websites or services that may be linked from our Site.

For questions about this policy, contact us at privacy@skyyrose.co.

2. Information We Collect

We collect the following categories of personal information:

A. Identifiers
Name (first and last)
Email address
Shipping and billing address
Phone number (if provided)
IP address and device identifiers
Account username and password (hashed)
B. Commercial Information
Order history (products purchased, quantities, prices)
Cart contents and wish lists
Return and exchange records
Pre-order records and estimated ship dates
C. Internet / Device Activity
Pages visited, time on page, referring URLs
Browser type and version, operating system
Clickstream data, search queries on the Site
Cookie identifiers and session tokens (see Section 7 and our Cookie Policy)
Advertising interaction data (ad views, clicks) via TikTok pixel and Google Analytics advertising features
D. Approximate Geolocation

We infer a general geographic location (city/region/country) from your IP address for analytics, fraud prevention, and currency/shipping-rate calculation. We do not collect precise GPS-level location data.

E. Payment Information

Payment card numbers and financial account details are collected and processed directly by our payment processors (Stripe and PayPal). We do not store payment card data on our servers. We retain only non-sensitive confirmation details such as the last four digits of a card, card type, and transaction identifiers returned by the processor.

3. How We Collect It
Directly from you

When you create an account, place an order, submit a return request, contact support, sign up for our email list, or otherwise interact with us, you provide information directly.

Automatically

When you visit the Site, we and our service providers automatically collect device and usage data through cookies, web beacons, pixel tags, and similar technologies. For a full description of these technologies and your controls, see Section 7 — Cookies & Tracking Technologies and our Cookie Policy.

From third parties
Payment processors (Stripe, PayPal): transaction confirmation data.
Analytics platforms (Google Analytics): aggregated and segmented usage data.
Advertising platforms (TikTok): ad interaction signals to measure campaign performance.
WordPress.com / Automattic (Jetpack): hosting, security scanning, and site-statistics data from our hosting and infrastructure provider.
4. How We Use Your Information

We use personal information for the following purposes:

Fulfill orders. Process payments, arrange shipping, send order confirmations and tracking updates, handle returns and exchanges.
Customer communications. Respond to inquiries, support tickets, and return/exchange requests via support@skyyrose.co.
Account management. Create and maintain customer accounts; enable order history and wishlist features.
Marketing with consent. Send promotional emails, new-collection announcements, and special offers where you have opted in. You may unsubscribe at any time.
Site improvement. Analyze usage patterns to improve navigation, content, and shopping experience.
Advertising. Measure ad performance and, where permitted, serve or retarget relevant advertising through TikTok and Google advertising features.
Fraud prevention and security. Detect and prevent fraudulent transactions, abuse, and unauthorized access.
Legal compliance. Meet our obligations under applicable law, respond to lawful requests from government authorities, and enforce our Terms of Service.
5. Legal Bases for Processing (GDPR)

If you are located in the European Economic Area (EEA) or United Kingdom, we process your personal data under the following legal bases:

Processing activity	Legal basis
Processing and fulfilling orders; managing returns; maintaining your account	Performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR)
Sending marketing emails; placing advertising cookies	Consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR) — you may withdraw at any time
Fraud prevention; site security; analytics to improve our services	Legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) — we have assessed that our interests do not override your rights
Complying with tax, accounting, consumer protection, and other legal obligations	Legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR)
6. How We Share & Disclose
Service providers and data processors

We share personal information with the following categories of vendors who process data on our behalf:

Processor / recipient	Role	Data shared
Stripe	Card payment processing (PCI-DSS compliant)	Payment and order details; card data handled exclusively by Stripe — never stored on SkyyRose servers
PayPal	Alternative payment processing	Order details; payment handled by PayPal on redirect
WordPress.com / Automattic (Jetpack)	Web hosting, infrastructure, security, Instant Search, site statistics, social sharing	All site traffic data processed under Automattic’s privacy infrastructure
Google Analytics	Site analytics and advertising measurement	Device/usage data via cookies; advertising features enabled (see Section 9)
TikTok (TikTok pixel)	Advertising performance measurement and audience building	Behavioral data shared for cross-context advertising (see Section 9)
WooCommerce	E-commerce engine (shopping cart, checkout, order management)	Order and session data; operated as part of the WordPress.com / Automattic infrastructure
Klaviyo	Email marketing platform	Email address, name, purchase history, and marketing preferences for subscribers
Legal and safety disclosures

We may disclose personal information when required by law, court order, or lawful government request; to protect the rights, property, or safety of SkyyRose, our customers, or others; or to detect, prevent, or investigate fraud.

Business transfers

If SkyyRose LLC is involved in a merger, acquisition, financing, reorganization, bankruptcy, or sale of assets, personal information may be transferred as part of that transaction. We will notify affected users via email or prominent Site notice prior to any such transfer and change of use.

We do not sell personal information for money

SkyyRose LLC does not sell your personal information to third parties for monetary compensation. However, our use of the TikTok pixel and Google Analytics advertising features may constitute “sharing” of personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising under California law. See Section 9 for how to opt out.

7. Cookies & Tracking Technologies

We use cookies, pixel tags, web beacons, and similar technologies to operate the Site, remember your preferences, analyze traffic, and serve targeted advertising. Cookies placed on our Site include:

Strictly necessary cookies: Required for cart functionality, checkout sessions, and security (WooCommerce session, WordPress login).
Analytics cookies: Google Analytics collects pseudonymous usage data to help us understand how visitors use the Site.
Advertising / targeting cookies: The TikTok pixel and Google advertising features track browsing behavior to measure ad performance and enable interest-based advertising.
Functional cookies: Jetpack and WordPress cookies that support site features such as search and sharing.

For a complete list of cookies we use, their purposes, durations, and your consent and opt-out controls, please see our Cookie Policy.

You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings. Note that disabling certain cookies may affect Site functionality.

8. Your California Privacy Rights (CCPA/CPRA)

If you are a California resident, the California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018 as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act of 2020 (CCPA/CPRA) grants you the following rights with respect to your personal information:

Right to Know

You may request that we disclose: the categories and specific pieces of personal information we have collected about you; the categories of sources from which we collected it; the business or commercial purpose for collecting or sharing it; and the categories of third parties to whom we disclosed it.

Right to Delete

You may request deletion of personal information we have collected from you, subject to certain exceptions (such as completing a transaction, detecting security incidents, or complying with a legal obligation).

Right to Correct

You may request correction of inaccurate personal information we maintain about you.

Right to Opt Out of Sale / Sharing

You have the right to opt out of the “sale” or “sharing” of your personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising. See Section 9 for how to exercise this right.

Right to Limit Use of Sensitive Personal Information

To the extent we process “sensitive personal information” as defined by CPRA (such as precise geolocation or financial account details), you may have the right to limit our use of such information to purposes necessary to provide the services you requested. We do not use sensitive personal information for any purpose beyond service delivery, and payment card data is handled exclusively by our PCI-compliant processors.

Right to Non-Discrimination

We will not discriminate against you for exercising any of your CCPA/CPRA rights. We will not deny you goods or services, charge you a different price, or provide you a different level of quality because you exercised a privacy right.

Categories collected and disclosed in the last 12 months
Category	Collected?	Disclosed to third parties for business purposes?	Sold or shared for cross-context behavioral advertising?
Identifiers (name, email, address, IP address)	Yes	Yes (processors listed in Section 6)	No sale; sharing via TikTok pixel / Google Ads features (see Section 9)
Commercial information (order history)	Yes	Yes (payment processors, email marketing provider)	No
Internet / device activity	Yes	Yes (Google Analytics, TikTok)	Sharing via TikTok pixel / Google Ads features (see Section 9)
Approximate geolocation	Yes (IP-derived)	Yes (analytics, hosting)	No
Payment / financial data	No (handled by processors only)	N/A	No
Sensitive personal information	No	N/A	No
How to submit a verifiable consumer request

To exercise your rights under CCPA/CPRA, submit a verifiable consumer request by:

Emailing privacy@skyyrose.co with the subject line “California Privacy Request”; or
Writing to us at: 3400 Cottage Way, Suite G2, Sacramento, CA 95825

We will respond within 45 days. We will need to verify your identity before processing the request; we may ask you to provide information that matches our records. You may designate an authorized agent to make a request on your behalf by providing written authorization or a power of attorney. We may still require you to verify your own identity directly with us.

California “Shine the Light” (Civil Code § 1798.83)

California residents may request information about personal information disclosed to third parties for their direct marketing purposes during the preceding calendar year. We do not disclose personal information to third parties for direct marketing purposes as defined under Shine the Light. To inquire, contact privacy@skyyrose.co.

9. Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information

Although we do not sell personal information for money, our use of the TikTok pixel and Google Analytics advertising features (including remarketing and audience-building) constitutes “sharing” of personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising under the CPRA. You have the right to opt out of this sharing.

How to opt out
Email request: Send an email to privacy@skyyrose.co with the subject line “Do Not Share My Personal Information.” We will process your request within 15 business days.
Cookie controls: You may disable advertising and analytics cookies through our Cookie Policy consent tool or through your browser settings. Disabling these cookies will prevent the TikTok pixel and Google advertising cookies from operating on your device.
Global Privacy Control (GPC): We honor the Global Privacy Control browser signal. If your browser or browser extension transmits a GPC signal, we will treat it as an opt-out of the sharing of your personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising from that browser on that device. Note that the GPC signal is device- and browser-specific and does not automatically apply to your account or other devices.
Platform-level opt-outs: You may also opt out of interest-based advertising through the TikTok app settings and through Google’s Ad Settings.

Opting out will not affect your ability to place orders or use any Site features.

10. Your Rights Under GDPR / UK GDPR

If you are located in the European Economic Area (EEA) or the United Kingdom, you have the following rights regarding your personal data under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and, where applicable, the UK GDPR:

Right of access (Art. 15): Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
Right to rectification (Art. 16): Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal data.
Right to erasure / “right to be forgotten” (Art. 17): Request deletion of your personal data, subject to certain exceptions (legal obligations, contractual necessity).
Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18): Request that we limit the way we use your data in certain circumstances.
Right to data portability (Art. 20): Receive personal data you have provided to us in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format, where technically feasible.
Right to object (Art. 21): Object to processing based on legitimate interests or for direct marketing purposes.
Right to withdraw consent: Where processing is based on your consent, you may withdraw that consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing prior to withdrawal.

To exercise any of these rights, email privacy@skyyrose.co. We will respond within 30 days (extendable by a further two months for complex requests, with notice to you).

Right to lodge a complaint

You have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection supervisory authority. For EEA residents, the relevant authority is in your member state of habitual residence, place of work, or the place of the alleged infringement. For UK residents, the relevant authority is the Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO) at ico.org.uk.

International data transfers

SkyyRose LLC is based in the United States. When we transfer personal data from the EEA or UK to the United States or other countries that may not provide the same level of data protection as your home country, we rely on appropriate safeguards, including Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission (and, for the UK, the UK Addendum to SCCs), or other lawful transfer mechanisms. You may request a copy of the applicable transfer mechanism by contacting privacy@skyyrose.co.

EU / UK Representative

SkyyRose LLC has determined that it is not required to appoint an EU or UK representative under Article 27 of the GDPR / UK GDPR. EEA and UK residents may exercise their rights or raise concerns by contacting us directly at privacy@skyyrose.co.

11. Children’s Privacy

The Site is a general-audience commercial website. Our Kids Capsule collection features children’s apparel, but all purchases are made by adults. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 years of age. If we learn that we have inadvertently collected personal information from a child under 13, we will delete it promptly.

If you believe we may have collected information from a child under 13, please contact us at privacy@skyyrose.co and we will investigate and take appropriate action.

1. Our Commitment

SkyyRose LLC is committed to digital accessibility for all users, including people with disabilities. We believe that everyone deserves equal access to our products, content, and services, regardless of the technology or assistive tools they use.

We work to maintain and improve the accessibility of skyyrose.co on an ongoing basis. Our goal is to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA, the internationally recognized standard for digital accessibility.

2. Conformance Status

We aim to conform to WCAG 2.1 Level AA. At this time, skyyrose.co is partially conformant with WCAG 2.1 Level AA. “Partially conformant” means that some parts of the site do not yet fully meet the standard, as described in the Known Limitations section below.

We are actively working to address identified gaps and improve conformance across all pages and features of the site.

3. Measures We Take

SkyyRose LLC takes the following measures to support and maintain accessibility:

Semantic HTML structure. Pages use semantic HTML5 elements (headings, landmarks, lists, tables) to convey document structure to assistive technologies. ARIA labels and roles are applied to interactive elements, navigation regions, and data tables where native semantics are insufficient.
Descriptive alternative text. Product images and meaningful visual content include descriptive alt attributes. Decorative images are marked with empty alt="" so screen readers skip them.
Keyboard operability. Navigation, product browsing, cart, and checkout flows are operable by keyboard alone. Focus is managed to remain visible and logical throughout the user flow.
Sufficient color contrast. Text and interactive elements are designed to meet or exceed WCAG 2.1 AA contrast ratios (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text and UI components).
Respect for motion preferences. Our scroll-reveal animations and 3D immersive experiences honor the prefers-reduced-motion CSS media query. When a user has enabled reduced-motion in their operating system, animations are suppressed and static fallback presentations are shown.
Ongoing review. We periodically review pages and components against accessibility standards and address findings in our regular development cycle.
4. Known Limitations

Despite our efforts, some areas of skyyrose.co may not yet fully conform to WCAG 2.1 Level AA. Known limitations include:

Third-party content. Embedded video players, payment processing widgets (Stripe, PayPal), and social media integrations are provided by third-party services. We do not control the accessibility of these components and cannot guarantee they meet WCAG 2.1 AA in all cases. We encourage these providers to improve their accessibility and will monitor their progress.
Immersive 3D experiences. Our collection immersive pages use interactive Three.js 3D scenes that may not be fully operable with all assistive technologies. Reduced-motion fallbacks are provided for users who have that system preference enabled, presenting a static layout in place of animated 3D content. Full WCAG compliance for complex 3D environments is an area of active improvement.
Legacy or cached content. Some older product images or embedded media may not yet have complete alt text or captioning. We are working to address these on a rolling basis.

If you encounter a barrier not listed here, please contact us using the information in the Feedback & Contact section below.

5. Compatibility

skyyrose.co is designed to be compatible with:

Recent versions of major browsers: Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Apple Safari, and Microsoft Edge.
Common assistive technologies, including screen readers such as NVDA (Windows), JAWS (Windows), VoiceOver (macOS/iOS), and TalkBack (Android).
Keyboard-only navigation on desktop operating systems.

Older browsers and legacy assistive technology versions may not fully support all features of the site. We recommend keeping your browser and assistive technology up to date for the best experience.

6. Feedback & Contact

We welcome feedback on the accessibility of skyyrose.co. If you experience a barrier, find that a page or feature is not accessible to you, or have suggestions for improvement, please contact us:

Email: support@skyyrose.co — we aim to respond within 2 business days.
Mailing address: SkyyRose LLC, 3400 Cottage Way, Suite G2, Sacramento, CA 95825

When contacting us, please describe the page or feature you were attempting to use and the nature of the barrier you encountered. This helps us reproduce and resolve the issue as quickly as possible.

7. Enforcement & Formal Complaints

SkyyRose LLC is committed to resolving accessibility concerns in good faith. If you have submitted a concern through the contact channel above and are not satisfied with our response, you have the right to escalate.

Under the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and other applicable law, individuals have the right to access places of public accommodation, which courts and regulators have increasingly interpreted to include commercial websites. If you believe your rights under the ADA or a comparable state or federal law have been violated, you may:

File a complaint with the U.S. Department of Justice, Civil Rights Division at ada.gov/filing_complaint.htm.
Contact the U.S. Access Board for questions about accessibility standards at access-board.gov.
Seek private legal remedies as may be available under applicable federal or state law.

We encourage you to contact us directly first — we are committed to working with you to find a solution.

8. Review Date

This Accessibility Statement was last reviewed on June 5, 2026. We review and update this statement periodically to reflect improvements to the site and changes in applicable standards.
